Extrapolation of current trends indicates an annual

Lessons from the past: explaining declines 
in mortality 
Three factors have been important in the dramatic 
and unprecedented mortality declines of the past 
hundred years and in the still more dramatic de­
clines in developing countries since World War II. 
These factors are income growth, improvements in 
medical technology, and public health programs 
combined with the spread of knowledge about 
health.
